sloka: कथंचिद्भवती दृष्टा न कालः परिशोचितुम् ।इम मुहूर्तं दुःखानामन्तं द्रक्ष्यसि भामिनि ।। ५.६७.२७ ।।।।
transliteration: kathaṁcidbhavatī dṛṣṭā na kālaḥ pariśocitum ।ima muhūrtaṁ duḥkhānāmantaṁ drakṣyasi bhāmini ।। 5.67.27 ।।।।

translations.english: "their zeal roused by the sight of you, shall reduce Lanka to ashes; and having slain in battle the terrible Ravana with his kinsmen,
